When a Bluetooth audio device connects, seat the last queue. On Android 17, playback stays paused until headset or media Play.
Car play starts when the head unit or Android Auto sends Play to your last media app. Enable Resume on Bluetooth to seat the queue; press Play on the wheel if needed.
After long sleep, set battery usage to Unrestricted so Bluetooth resume can start in the background.

Battery unrestricted — background resume after sleep is allowed
Open system Settings and set battery usage to Unrestricted for reliable Bluetooth resume after deep sleep
